title: Document Studio (M2)
summary: Describes the 7-step Studio authoring wizard, its per-document state storage, Tauri command surface, M4 export pipeline, and frontmatter/provenance invariants.
notes: Competing SPEC vs DOC signals: prose-heavy description of already-shipped behavior (DOC), but dominant content is implementation contracts — Tauri command names (studio_state_*, studio_apply_body, template_get_fields, template_fill_hwpx, export_*), state file layout .maru/studio/<doc-id>/state.json, manifest.yaml as export SSOT, and a 'Related invariants' section (frontmatter byte-identity, provenance frontmatter keys). Resolved to SPEC per ambiguity rule (SPEC > DOC) so the invariants survive as technical constraints. No frontmatter, no numbered/spec filename convention, no schema or endpoint tables — hence medium, not high. Referenced paths are source-code files, not documents, so cross_refs is empty.
